listings.condition_raw: Live Edge S2S Coastal Cedar 1 x 12 x 107 $142 This exceptional old growth coastal cedar was milled by Earthwise on private land that was clear cut by loggers in the 1960s. These huge logs were left behind and forgotten for 60 years, but are in amazingly good condition thanks to cedar's rot resistant properties. Due to the harsh growing conditions on the coast, only the strongest and slowest growing trees survive, yielding incredibly tight grain lumber. Old growth cedar is very rare and used in making musical instruments, carved masks, fine furniture, and whatever awesome projects EW customers can dream up! This lumber was milled to minimize waste, so there is a mix of live edge and lumber of various sizes available. 8.19 BF

These huge logs were left behind and forgotten for 60 years, but are in amazingly good condition thanks to cedar's rot resistant properties. Due to the harsh growing conditions on the coast, only the strongest and slowest growing trees survive, yielding incredibly tight grain lumber. Old growth cedar is very rare and used in making musical instruments, carved masks, fine furniture, and whatever awesome projects EW customers can dream up! listings.condition_raw: S2S Old Growth Coastal Cedar 4 x 7.25 x 98.5 $230 per board This exceptional old growth coastal cedar was milled by Earthwise on private land that was clear cut by loggers in the 1960s. These huge logs were left behind and forgotten for 60 years, but are in amazingly good condition thanks to cedar's rot resistant properties. Due to the harsh growing conditions on the coast, only the strongest and slowest growing trees survive, yielding incredibly tight grain lumber. Old growth cedar is very rare and used in making musical instruments, carved masks, fine furniture, and whatever awesome projects EW customers can dream up! This lumber was milled to minimize waste, so there is a mix of live edge and lumber of various sizes available. 19.83 BF For more information, please view our blog post and Instagram video https://ewsalvage.com/new-to-earthwise-truly-ancient-coastal-cedar-lumber/u00a0 https://www.instagram.com/reel/C-rYCoixg9n/?hl=enu00a0

listings.condition_raw: Old Growth Coastal Cedar 2.5 x 19.125 x 36.75 $244 This exceptional old growth coastal cedar was milled by Earthwise on private land that was clear cut by loggers in the 1960s. These huge logs were left behind and forgotten for 60 years, but are in amazingly good condition thanks to cedar's rot resistant properties. Due to the harsh growing conditions on the coast, only the strongest and slowest growing trees survive, yielding incredibly tight grain lumber. Old growth cedar is very rare and used in making musical instruments, carved masks, fine furniture, and whatever awesome projects EW customers can dream up! This lumber was milled to minimize waste, so there is a mix of live edge and lumber of various sizes available. For more information, please view our blog post https://ewsalvage.com/new-to-earthwise-truly-ancient-coastal-cedar-lumber/ and instagram video https://www.instagram.com/reel/C-rYCoixg9n/?hl=en

limitations: Support alignment is checked against existing member projections; connection contact and engineering remain NOT_YET_RUN.
Perimeter terminations are not claimed to be verified supports.
Parallel strip recipes use real board widths; boards within a strip share width and may differ in thickness and source.
Internal support-end band seams use the existing research gap; no new supports are created.
Structural and first-pass residuals are explicit interval-tracked OFFCUT supply; frozen assignments are unchanged.
Edge rips are modeled fabrication operations, not confirmation that a saw operation has physically occurred.

Remove unnecessary unsupported coverage or redesign the panel boundary and host relation.
Resolve assembly intent when no generic host action is defensible.
